The exact closed-model reachability facts exclude state:PumpState:line:4 from the root-reachable set; the supplied counterexample reaches PumpControl.UnspecifiedInitial instead. The nested PumpRegion initial edge is a different owner-local route and does not provide a root path to PumpState, so no competent alternative defeats the reading.

decisions.basis: Pair-0053 NL3 action dossier with exact PumpState source/model binding and the supplied empty action inventory.
decisions.reason: The NL3 clause assigns PumpState the behavior of activating or controlling the pump. The exact source/body projection contains that authored description, but the supplied closed-model action inventory has no entry and no exact lifecycle action carrier is bound to state:PumpState:line:4. The body text is therefore not evidence of an executable action field. Predicate unavailability does not create the semantic finding; the precise source/model facts establish the missing executable binding.
decisions.violated_obligation: PumpState must perform the action of activating or controlling the pump.

decisions.basis: Pair-0053 NL4/NL5 scope dossier with exact PumpControl subtree inventory and transition facts.
decisions.reason: The supplied operating-sequence clauses require named-state behavior that continues across the PumpControl operating states. The complete exact subtree inventory contains no transitions sourced from PumpState, WaterState, or MethaneState; all listed scoped transitions are pseudo-state entries, and the named states have no outgoing behavior. Pseudo-state entry edges can initialize regions but cannot realize named-state continuation. No competent alternative reading is supported.
decisions.violated_obligation: The PumpControl operating scope must provide continuing named-state behavior across its operating states.

issues.reason: The exact PumpControl-owned initial edge targets UnspecifiedInitial, not PumpState. The required PumpState edge is therefore absent from the owner-local initial-entry relation, despite a separate nested PumpRegion initial edge existing.
issues.requirement_quote: The system first transitions to the PumpState substate, where the pump is activated or controlled.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The nested PumpRegion initial edge does target PumpState, but it is owned by PumpRegion rather than PumpControl and cannot satisfy the contract's exact owner scope.
issues.title: PumpControl enters the wrong initial substate

issues.basis: NL4; exact source endpoint binding; closed transition inventory lines 18, 16, 5, 9, and 13 has no transition whose resolved source is PumpState and target is WaterState.
issues.expected: A transition exists from PumpState to WaterState.
issues.observed: No closed transition connects PumpState to WaterState.
issues.reason: PumpState and WaterState resolve to exact closed states, and the complete closed transition inventory contains only initial edges; it contains no PumpState-to-WaterState transition.
issues.requirement_quote: The system can also transition to the WaterState substate, indicating that the pump is controlling or monitoring the water flow.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The source author transition inventory does not contain a separate PumpState-to-WaterState edge either; only the WaterRegion initial edge reaches WaterState, which is a different source and scope.
issues.title: Required PumpState to WaterState transition is absent

issues.basis: NL5; exact source endpoint binding; closed inventory contains only initial edges, including separate region initial edges to WaterState and MethaneState, not the required operating transition.
issues.expected: A transition exists from WaterState to MethaneState.
issues.observed: No closed transition connects WaterState to MethaneState.
issues.reason: WaterState and MethaneState resolve to exact closed states, and the complete closed transition inventory contains no WaterState-to-MethaneState edge.
issues.requirement_quote: Similarly, the system can transition to the MethaneState substate, indicating that the pump is controlling or monitoring the methane flow.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: MethaneState has its own region initial edge, but that edge does not establish the required WaterState source or operating transition.
issues.title: Required WaterState to MethaneState transition is absent
